newsitem.title: FINLAND: Den Danske holds match+ rating for Kemira.
newsitem.headline: Den Danske holds match+ rating for Kemira.

text.p: Danish bank Den Danske Bank said in a statement received on Thursday it was holding its match+ rating for Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy.
In the statement dated January 8, Den Danske said it had lowered its profit forecasts for 1997 and 1998 after Kemira's announcement on Tuesday its pigments unit had a 1996 loss.

"We have lowered our estimates for Pigments and also for the whole group," Den Danske said, adding it had cut its forecasts for Kemira's consolidated earnings for 1997 by six percent and for 1998 by five percent.
The match+ rating means that the stock is expected to outperform from nil to five percent over the next 12 months.
The brokerage said it was holding its match+ rating for Kemira since the stock was trading with a significant discount compared to the Finnish stock market and the branch.
Den Danske forecast Kemira's earnings per share to rise to 6.4 markka in 1997 and to 7.5 markka in 1998 from 4.9 markka in 1996.
